q: What is the resting breathing rate?
When did jogging stop? How do you know?
At 3 minutes: the rate is highest there and then falls.
Explain why breathing rate rises during exercise.
Muscles respire faster and need more oxygen, and more carbon dioxide must be removed.
Suggest why the rate stays above resting for several minutes after jogging stops.
The body must take in extra oxygen to break down lactic acid and remove the carbon dioxide built up (repaying the oxygen debt).
